scope: Read-only operator-driver and pure accepted-plan projection review. No API action, approval, inference, model write, or test run.
observations: Driver restricts host to explicit isolated loopback origin and non-product port; actual source/build/project identities are checked.
Each mutating invocation requires separately inspected hash-bound evidence and performs one normal NIS API action; no synthetic hardware, technical-profile fixture or direct SQL is supplied.
Start reproduces the pure product adapter projection from the actual current ACCEPTED record, checks exact design/revision/request identity and rejects caller-appended prompt/context.

Projection imports actual referenceDesignMarker and extractEngineeringSpecification; raw original request and actual accepted marker remain in prompt, with counts/technologies derived from product extraction.
Proposal review compares the whole actual proposal and exact revision; preflight acknowledgement is limited to the current READY_WITH_WARNINGS snapshot with separately reviewed evidence.
Driver explicitly records simulation_pass/full_release_pass/productive_delivery false and does not claim nine-stage browser E2E.
limitations: No actual accepted record/model export is available for independent robot source-to-model verification yet.
Actual project-ID form and raw/wrapped source identity must be checked against real records when present; no assumptions should override a mismatch.
This static review does not approve any actual proposal, preflight finding or simulation result.
